fieldValues.title: RFC-051 whole-outline replace: may the owner's 2026-10-24 rule on srs#940 be recorded as a decision, so the correction revision becomes group work?
fieldValues.thinking_reached: Checked 2026-11-09 at srs 1461d01 and srs-rust 17983f2. RFC-051 [R8] says which entry files a Change D operation writes, but not a whole-outline replace or swap. srs-rust implements a rule for it (crates/srs-core/src/container_write.rs:138, 310: the longest run already in key order keeps its keys, the rest are rewritten). On srs#940 (2026-10-24T14:46Z) the owner wrote: 'After the rollout: write the whole-outline replace rule into RFC-051 as a correction revision'. The rollout is done (srs-rust#1414 sub-issues all closed, srs#949 closed, corpora at revision 11), RFC-051 is still Revision 15 and still Accepted, not Implemented. Under decision 0b1c25b1 an issue comment is not a ruling, and the revision is Door 3 (an Accepted RFC's own surface), so it is not group work until the choice is recorded.
fieldValues.tensions: Option A: record the 2026-10-24 choice as a decision (whole-outline replace keeps the longest in-order run's keys), then the correction revision is Door 1 work and RFC-051 can be marked Implemented after it. Option B: mark RFC-051 Implemented now and leave the rule as implementation-defined. Option C: a different rule (rewrite all keys on a whole-outline replace), which would change srs-rust. Third-party readiness (Portability) pulls toward A: a second implementation needs the rule written down.
fieldValues.unresolved_questions: 1. Does the owner confirm the 2026-10-24 wording as the rule? 2. Should srs#940 and srs-rust#1414 close once it is folded? Evidence that would choose: none needed beyond the owner's confirmation; srs-rust already behaves per option A.
fieldValues.blocking: The RFC-051 correction revision, marking RFC-051 Implemented, and closing srs#940 and srs-rust#1414 (all six sub-issues closed).
fieldValues.next_action: Owner: confirm option A. Recommendation: A; the Steward records the decision, the analyst files the correction revision as group work.
